prompt: Describe visible scientific or regulatory content qualitatively. Preserve uncertainty. For EVERY observation set caption_quote to the empty string "". Do not transcribe, paraphrase, translate or reconstruct captions into caption_quote. Native caption text is preserved separately by extraction. Use target "page" when the association with a supplied candidate ID is uncertain or there are no candidates. Never invent candidate IDs. Keep observation qualitative and free of numeric characters. Record limitations explicitly.
